title: Find a Safer Drivers Course provider
summary: Find a provider for the Safer Drivers Course, which is a combined theory and practical course for learner drivers.
intro:
The Safer Drivers Course is a combined theory and practical course for learner drivers who:

1000 free places are offered each year for learner drivers from disadvantaged backgrounds who meet the requirements listed above, and:

The course helps you understand more about speed management, gap selection, hazard awareness and safe following distances, and prepares you for when you drive unsupervised on your Provisional licence.

You receive 20 hours of log book credit when you complete the course.

faqs.q: What does the Safer Drivers Course cover?
faqs.a: The course helps you understand speed management, gap selection, hazard awareness, and safe following distances, preparing you for unsupervised driving on your Provisional licence.

faqs.q: How many log book credits do I receive after completing the course?
faqs.a: You receive 20 hours of log book credit when you complete the course.

faqs.q: Are there free places available for the Safer Drivers Course?
faqs.a: 1000 free places are offered each year for learner drivers from disadvantaged backgrounds who meet the requirements.
